title: Let service steady your honor
summary: A servant's honor rests with the Master, not the room. Receive the dignity already being given.
takeaway: Receive the dignity already being given.
lifeApplication: When pride starts arguing with the day, place a hand on the chest before the replay begins. Say, "I am Yours," and let the Beloved's way steady your honor.

source.shortMeaning: A servant's honor rests with the Master, not the room.
source.lifeApplication: When bruised pride flares, hand your honor back to the One you serve.

evidence.coreClaim: A servant's honor rests with the Master, not the room.
evidence.turn: Let the Beloved's way grow dearer than the mind's protest.
evidence.practicalImplication: When pride starts arguing with the day, place a hand on the chest before the replay begins. Say, "I am Yours," and let the Beloved's way steady your honor.
